name: DS2 Scott Probe
about: DS2 Scott Probe (1999-001, JPL), launched 1999 Jan  3. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.978 au and aphelion 1.446 au against GCAT's 0.972 and 1.455
